records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_compare_dialog.MeasurementComparePanel.apply_workspace_state#1
records.source: Recognized, correctly typed entries are applied independently. Unknown fixed choices are ignored; measurement and class identifiers that are not yet offered remain pending until an ordinary refresh or data update. Selected guide and well identifiers are retained without reading files. An active join owned by this panel is cancelled so its late result cannot replace the restored state. No new join, file read or inference starts. The cached comparison and figure remain unchanged until the next refresh.
records.context: Recognized, correctly typed entries are applied independently.
